title: Part Library entries from before the release stay listed
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Part Library entry {Library-entry-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-OLDENTRY-01) existed before the Part Lifecycle build was deployed and has no part behind it ("Total parts" 0).
  • Part Library entry {Library-entry-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-OLDENTRY-02) existed before the deployment and has a part behind it ("Total parts" 1 or more).
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Part Library in the left menu.
  2. Type {Library-entry-A} in the Search box.
  3. Click the {Library-entry-A} row.
  4. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  5. Type {Library-entry-B} in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: {Library-entry-A} is still listed although nothing uses it.
  • Step 3: Its detail page opens and shows "Total parts" 0: the release neither deleted nor hid it.
  • Step 5: {Library-entry-B} is still listed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S11-E1, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 7.1 (Part Library), board 7.2 (An entry opens its detail page), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-E1: “Part Library entries that exist on the day of release stay in the list, including the ones nothing references. This spec does not delete or hide them.”
  • PRD Story 11 context note: “No standalone create is what keeps that number from growing.”
